checker.title: Revit version checker
checker.pageTitle: Revit Version Checker: Which Version Is This File? {'|'} Revit Downgrade
checker.description: Free tool: see which Revit version saved a .rvt, .rfa, .rte or .rft file, without opening Revit. Check a whole folder and download the list as CSV.
checker.intro: See which Revit version saved a file, without opening Revit. Check one file or a whole folder.
checker.drop: or drop them here. Up to {max} files at a time.
checker.privacy: Your files stay on your computer: they are read in this browser and nothing is uploaded.
checker.nothingFound: No Revit files found. Only .rvt, .rfa, .rte and .rft files are checked.
checker.leftOut: {count} more Revit files were left out: at most {max} are checked at a time.
checker.next: Need one of these in an older Revit?

problem.not_ole: Not a Revit file, or the file is damaged
problem.not_revit: This file does not say which Revit saved it
problem.unreadable: The file could not be read

sections.heading: How does it know the version?
sections.body: Every Revit file carries a small block of information about the Revit that saved it. Your browser reads only that block, so even a large model takes a moment and Revit does not need to be installed.
